# Palworld Sphere Tracking rank rollback

This public guide records one player-confirmed rank-1-to-0 workaround in a modded Steam/Windows game on 2026-10-04. The root cause and applicability to other environments are unverified.

- [Chinese guide](https://cola113.github.io/palworld-sphere-homing-fix/)
- [English guide](https://cola113.github.io/palworld-sphere-homing-fix/en/)
- [English Markdown](https://github.com/Cola113/palworld-sphere-homing-fix/blob/main/README.md)
- [Chinese Markdown](https://github.com/Cola113/palworld-sphere-homing-fix/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md)
- [Sanitized case record](https://cola113.github.io/palworld-sphere-homing-fix/case-study.json)
- [Results and corrections](https://github.com/Cola113/palworld-sphere-homing-fix/issues)

Key distinction: RelicPossessNumMap[EPalRelicType::SphereHoming] is the unspent effigy count. The bought rank is the StatusPoint integer for パルスフィアホーミング in the correct player's GotStatusPointList in Level.sav. In this case rank 1 became 0, held count 0 became 1, and pickup flags remained true. The full guide includes backups, format support, verification and scope limits.
